name: Air Fryer Beef Meatball Subs with Marinara

components.name: Meatballs in Marinara
steps: Mix raw beef with breadcrumbs, beef stock, Parmesan, parsley, garlic, salt and pepper until evenly incorporated. Shape into 16 equal meatballs, using 4 per sub.
Preheat the air fryer to 195 C. Arrange meatballs in a single layer and cook in batches for about 10-14 minutes, turning or shaking midway, until all centres reach 71 C.
While the meatballs cook, soften onion in olive oil in a saucepan, add garlic and tomato paste, then pour in crushed tomatoes. Simmer gently until thick enough to coat the meatballs.
For meal prep, keep cooked meatballs in sauce separate from rolls until serving. Freeze meatballs and sauce if desired; do not freeze raw greens.

components.name: Rolls, Cheese & Greens

ingredients.name: Four sandwich bread rolls at 80 g each
Fresh lettuce or salad greens for the side

steps: Combine cooked meatballs with the warm marinara. Split the four rolls, add four meatballs and sauce to each, and top with the measured cheese.
Air fry filled rolls for 2-3 minutes until cheese has melted and bread is lightly toasted. Serve with a measured portion of raw greens.
